strings.en: I won't run... and neither will you!
Don't you dare... make me angry!
Alright, I can do it at this range!
Sorry, but you're not getting away...!
With the Armorlion, I can do this!
Don't take this for an ordinary Lion...!
With this Exbein Boxer, I can do it!
The Exbein Gunner can catch it!
What on earth are they doing with Lieutenant Calvina...
I can't let Jua-Mu do as he pleases...!
I won't let you lay a hand on/　Touya and Princess Shana-Mia!
Al-Van, you'll have to deal with me too!
I can't show an opening/　to a Fury knight...!
A black Raftclans... I have to be careful...!
If you mean to eliminate the people of Earth,/　I can't allow it!
What on earth are they after...?!
To run into the Balshem in a place like this...!
So that's the Balshem commander unit...!
If you won't stop interfering with the Earth Sphere!
I can't let that attitude throw me off...!
To think they'd bring out the Baran-Schneil...!
Is he really the head of Golaikunru...?!
I have to get to Rabulpaila quickly...!
I'll break through here no matter what!
That machine's mobility can't be underestimated...!
A crimson Gyanonia... I have to break through it!
I can't let that man/　use the Cross Gate...!
Is he really controlling/　the Cross Gate like that...?!
So that's one of the Dark Brain's subordinates...!
I have to watch out for Debudedabide's tricks...!
I'm curious about the cause, but right now, the pilot...!
Anyway, I have to stop that machine now...!
I'll stop the Crystal Dragoon in its tracks!
I have to watch out for the Skull Knight's range...!
Skull Knight, I won't let you do/　as you please in this world!
Skull Knight... a name that fits its looks.
What could there possibly be/　after wiping out intelligent life...?!
I won't let XN-L go anywhere!/　I'll sink it right here!
If I take down the Commander's unit...!
I have to watch out for its range...!
The Kareitsedo's charging power/　is not to be underestimated...!
Don't think a barrage can stop me!
I have to draw the enemy over here...!
There's not enough data to call it/　a Zovorg machine, but...
And to get data on the new model too...!
It feels like a different lineage/　from the Zovorg machines...!
White Horn... I can't let my guard down!
So that's the commander unit... it looks highly mobile.
Thorn, huh. I'd better be careful...!
The Gyanonia is an opponent to watch out for...!
Those large thrusters.../　it must be highly mobile.
A mass of negative thought.../　I have to eliminate it quickly!
We can't let them occupy Shinjuku!
I have to defeat the Lamaris quickly...!
I can't leave the Kaana types alone!
The Kaana types are fusing even further...!
I have to annihilate the Ida type here...!
The Ares Geist has appeared again...!
The reason Ares Geist appeared here...!
To draw it away from the Cross Gate...!
I have to get rid of the Yokijin!
I can't let Yokijin slow me down!
I won't just back off quietly... No way!
I can't keep dealing/　with you forever!
I can't let myself get held up here!
I won't let it end like this!
I-Is this the limit/　of what I can do...!?
Ngh! I have no choice but to eject!
Agh! I-I can't win like this!?
Ugh! I can't run away... not here...!
S-So strong! At this rate,/　I'm going down...!
Ahh!/　...I-I managed to hold out, but...!
I-I'm not the same as I used to be!/　That's why!
I won't give up! There has to be/　something I can still do!
There's something I have to do!/　I can't die here!
The Boxer can still take it!
The main thruster's fine, I can still fly!
Herluga can't be allowed/　to keep that power!
Even Debudedabide's tricks/　must have a set pattern...!
XN-L, I can't accept/　the conclusion you've reached...!!
No good, I have to handle the Raftclans/　better!
As expected of a new model...! Fast reactions!
Ugh! So they have plenty/　of data on us!
Ugh...!/　Did I take a direct hit...!?
Checking damaged areas.../　Okay, I can still fight.
Ngh! If I manually correct/　the unit's balance somewhat...!
The thrusters weren't damaged.../　As long as it moves, the rest...!
Ugh!/　I can't go down in a place like this...!
Ngh! Where did it hit me!?
I won't flinch at something like this!
The Exbein itself hasn't taken any damage!
Jua-Mu... has he gotten better than before?!
That attack...!/　They don't care if they damage their own ship...?!
Ngh, I have to take out that machine's thrusters...!
Is it dangerous to fight at Reggiane's range...!
Using the Cross Gate/　can't possibly end well...!
At this rate, I'll play right into Debudedabide's hands...!
Ngh! I can't keep up with the Crystal Dragoon!
Did I misjudge the Skull Knight's range...!
I can't let XN-L go to Earth!
I need to update Thorn's data...!
Ngh, I have to respond to the Raftclans/　faster...!
If I take too long, I'll activate them...!
I can't shake off the Lamaris Kaana...!
The Ares Geist is getting faster...!
A Yokijin's got its teeth in me...!
It grazed me!? But I'm okay!
It moved like that...!?/　I need to update the enemy data.
No problem, but.../　I should recalculate just in case.
This much damage is within tolerance.
Oh no, this'll just make more work/　for the maintenance crew...
I need to RT-arrange my evasion motions...!
That's not enough to stop the Gunner!
Ngh, I couldn't read Al-Van's movements...!
Gomoudokka... so you're not all talk.
Did I get caught up in Reggiane's pace...!
I have to pull the Floraga/　away from the Cross Gate...!
I have to see through Debudedabide's movements...!
Crystal Dragoon... its aim is precise.
I have to stop XN-L here no matter what...!
I have to see through Thorn's movements...!
I didn't think I was underestimating the Raftclans...!
I can't waste time on the Lamaris...!
That pattern won't work on me!
Sorry, but I already know your moves.
I knew you'd come at me like that!
This unit's nimbler than it looks.
I'm handling the add-on parts fine...!/　This'll work!
Beefing up the verniers paid off.
Karo-Ran, things won't go your way!
Not as fast as a Raftclans...!
Gomoudokka, this won't go as you calculated!
It's faster than Vort's Gyanonia, but...!
There's no time, I have to stop the Floraga quickly!
You won't hit me, Crystal Dragoon!
I've fought this enemy many times. It won't hit me.
We've gotten our hands/　on your data too!
If I can distract the commander...!
I'll gather all the data on the Thorn I can...!
I can't let that thing possess me...!
New look, same old brute force, huh...!
Good, this evasion pattern/　will come in handy.
Once I get a feel for this machine,/　this is nothing!
Looks like my calculations were right.
That one was a little too close...
I'll keep dodging till the end...!
Even if this works,/　I can't let my guard down...
I wish they'd just give up now...
I'm always updating my evasion motions.
Is that commander unit trying to pin us down...?!
It's dangerous to get surrounded./　I need to be careful...!
I need to watch out for that lance...!
This might be a bit underhanded, but...
Looks like the Jammer did its job.
They're a step ahead of me...!
Ngh, at this rate,/　they'll just keep toying with me...!
Sorry,/　but I can't let you get away...!
Rio, leave the rest to me!
I can't waste the chance/　Rio made for me!
I know, Rio. I'll take it from here!
Rio, from here on it's my job!
Yuuki, I'm coming in from this side!
Radha, I'll take it from here!
Ryoto here! Captain, I'll cover you!
Lieutenant, leave the rest to me!
Kota, don't get ahead of yourself!
Fiona, leave the rest to me!
Josh, leave the rest to me!
Lieutenant Hugo, I'll back you up!
Ing, I'll take it from here!
Arieil, leave the rest to me!
Akimi, I'm moving in to cover!
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
Rio, don't charge in too far!
Bullet, leave that one to me!
Yuuki, you need to pull out!
Radha, pull out while you can!
Sorry, but I'm going all out!
I won't give you a chance to escape!
I won't let this chance slip!
It's not just the fists and armor/　that got an upgrade!
All targets locked! Here I go!
With this... there should be no escape!
Even I can handle the R-Blade...!
Two baleful stars in the heavens...!
There's no escaping an evil star.
Evil stars in a row shatter lucky gods/　and return them to the earth...!
With Raptor and Bison working together!
If I miss this,/　I'm gonna be in real trouble...!
There's this way to use the Boxer, too!
This is the Boxer's new power!
Ain't no problem at all, Funny Voice.
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
An evil star in the heavens, a spirit star on earth!
Did you see the evil star twinkle?!
